summary_en: JM Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 1,940,000 shares (3.81% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 2.0 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between September 14, 2026, and July 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On September 11, 2026, the Board of Directors of JM Holdings resolved to acquire treasury stock as a flexible capital policy. The company is authorized to repurchase up to 1.94 million shares, representing 3.81% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum outlay of 2.0 billion yen. Purchases will be executed through open market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over a ten-month period from September 14, 2026, through July 31, 2027. The repurchase is intended to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns through more agile capital management.
